decisions.reason: The organic vegan superfood drink mix is peripheral to the firm's chemical core, has only a minor website mention, and any disappointing results cannot be attributed to temporary causes given the poor strategic fit.
The modular waste-to-energy plant extension aligns with the firm's environmental technology direction and has received public commitment, so management persists despite any early problems.
The waste oil to energy plant has its own webpage, indicating strong visible commitment and likely high sunk investment, making discontinuation unlikely.
The plastic waste to fuel plant fits the firm's chemical recycling capabilities and has been publicly mentioned, leading to escalation of commitment.
